postal_system.assignment_rule: The UPU September 2025 Universal DataBase lists Jamaica among countries which do not require postal codes. The UPU May 2021 Jamaica sheet explicitly states that Jamaica has no postcode system and distinguishes Kingston one- and two-digit sector codes. Current Jamaica Post pages use Kingston sector suffixes in place names but publish no national postcode assignment table. A Kingston sector, parish, locality, office, route, commerce ZIP placeholder, AGID value or synthetic JM seed is not a Jamaica postcode.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No national postcode assignments exist to anchor postcode Polygon or MultiPolygon records. Island, parish, Kingston sector, district, administrative, locality, office, route, service-area, Point, buffer, hull, cell and synthetic geometry must remain independently typed and must not be relabelled as postal geometry.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, organization, house or building number, street, Kingston sector or locality, town, parish and Jamaica as separate fields. Do not insert a fabricated postcode into domestic addresses.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Post offices, boxes, routes, organizations and other service objects remain independently typed. A non-area object never becomes a postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon without an authoritative code assignment and reviewed geometry relationship.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires separately rights-cleared civic-address identity and an explicit reviewed relation to point or footprint geometry. A parish, locality, Kingston sector, office, route, coordinate or synthetic code is not an address-building relation.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Models and realtime services may validate an address or service location only under source-specific rights. For JM they must return no-postcode or independently typed context, never manufacture a code or postal surface.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. JM planning cells may index separately authorized context but are never Jamaica Post codes or postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: Jamaica Post pages state All Rights Reserved and the UPU restricts reproduction, transmission and database use. No AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution or public-serving right for a postal dataset is inferred from web access.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: Preserve ISO JM identity and Jamaica's territory. Do not merge or borrow code assignments or geometry from any other Caribbean country or territory.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Addresses, recipients, postal-box holders, parcel observations, coordinates, buildings and query logs can expose personal or property context and are excluded absent explicit authority and minimisation.
postal_system.temporal_rule: No-postcode status is time-dependent. Preserve retrieval time, edition, exact bytes and SHA-256, and re-check after the pending-country sweep or a Jamaica Post or UPU announcement.

stages.definition: Jamaica address-format inventory, draft country pack, synthetic planning cells and conformance fixtures only.
Digest-bound Jamaica Post and UPU evidence that Jamaica currently has no postcode system, plus rights, identity, privacy, address-format correction and no-proxy contracts.

M2 requires a current authoritative Jamaica Post or competent public release establishing a Jamaica postcode system and a complete finite denominator of every code assignment, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and explicit non-area object, fixed with retrieval time, edition, stable identity, schema, coverage, bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. The UPU September 2025 list says Jamaica does not require postal codes and the UPU May 2021 Jamaica sheet says Jamaica has no postcode system; Kingston one- and two-digit sector codes are locality-sector suffixes, not national postcode assignments. Absence is represented as none and does not satisfy the Polygon/MultiPolygon milestone. If a future system is introduced, every drawable code must reconcile to fixed real Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry with postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source, edition, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions. Island, parish, Kingston sector, district, locality, address, office, route, service area, parcel, building, Point, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster cell, AGID cell, commerce ZIP placeholder and synthetic JM planning code are prohibited proxies. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real JM API/app, handling no-code/no-match, loading, multiple, failure and invalid geometry states, map fit, translucent fill, clear outline, clear/re-search, and display of code, geometry kind, class, source, date and confidence.

agid_integration.current_scope: JM metadata, no-postcode policy, address-format correction and synthetic planning fixtures only; no real JM Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A future authoritative postcode release, compatible rights, immutable assignment and geometry artifacts, and actual JM loader/API/app verification are required.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture a Jamaica postal polygon. Independently licensed context remains typed and source-qualified.
